comparison: Perfect agreement on claims C2, C3, C23-C28 regarding Arfrp1 knockdown effects on Vangl2 localization. Both evaluations find the evidence convincing and well-controlled, rating the claims as SUPPORTED.
Perfect agreement on claims C29-C33 regarding Arfrp1-AP-1 interaction data. Both evaluations accept the affinity chromatography and mass spectrometry evidence as SUPPORTED without raising concerns.

Agreement on claims C6-C8, C34, C36, C38, C40-C43 regarding the YYXXF motif. Both rate as SUPPORTED, though peer review raises a mechanistic question about why motif mutation causes complete block while Arfrp1 knockdown causes partial block.

Agreement on claims C44-C53 regarding direct Vangl2-AP-1 binding. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED, with peer review seeking deeper mechanistic understanding about the role of specific residues rather than challenging the data.

Strong agreement on claims C54-C60 regarding AP-1 knockdown effects. Both rate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval includes C57 while peer review does not, but both accept the overall evidence as convincing and well-controlled.

Partial overlap on liposome flotation claims. Both rate as SUPPORTED for claims C61-C66. OpenEval notes modest enhancement and suggests need for additional replicates; peer review accepts data but seeks structural precedent for the proposed model.

Partial overlap on claims C67-C69 regarding Arf1 vs Arfrp1 differential effects. Both rate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval focuses on comparative liposome data (C67-C72), while peer review addresses broader liposome findings (C61-C69) and asks about mechanistic details.

Agreement on claims C4-C5, C76-C81 regarding Frizzled 6 and Celsr1 independence from Arfrp1/AP-1. OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED while peer review rates as UNCERTAIN, requesting more rigorous testing and noting the lack of AP-1 sorting signals makes the finding unsurprising.

Agreement on claims C82-C85 regarding PTK7 dependence on Arfrp1. OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED with caveats about subtle effects; peer review rates as UNCERTAIN, requesting the authors tone down conclusions and explain why different experimental strategy was needed.

Perfect agreement on claims C86-C92 regarding PKD requirement. Both rate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes C91-C92 are speculative models extending beyond direct evidence; peer review accepts the data without challenge as part of the overall positive assessment.

Perfect agreement on claims C99-C100 regarding lack of Arl1 involvement. Both rate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes lack of presented data as limitation; peer review accepts negative data but requests discussion of possible Arl1 role based on other literature.

Agreement on claims C9, C114-C115, C119-C120 regarding the proposed mechanistic model. Both rate as UNCERTAIN. OpenEval notes model is speculative and lacks direct structural evidence; peer review asks for structural precedent and conservation data before accepting the model.
OpenEval evaluated claims C1, C10-C13, C73 as SUPPORTED background statements from literature. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these contextual claims.

OpenEval evaluated extensive background claims C14-C22, C35, C93-C98, C101-C112, C116-C118 as SUPPORTED literature citations. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these contextual claims.
OpenEval evaluated claims C37, C39 as SUPPORTED regarding expression-dependent localization of YYXXF mutants. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these specific observations.
OpenEval evaluated claim C121 as UNCERTAIN regarding speculative extension to polarized epithelial cells. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for this speculative model.
